My partner and I have been working as cleaners at the local stadium for the last 3 years. We don't have any medical issues, we just need enough space for our kids to grow up in. On top of all this, the landlord has decided to sell the property and has served us a Section 21 notice, so we are now threatened with homelessness as well. As a Caribbean man I know that family is everything to my partner and I, which is why we are applying.
